spans.s:
Hot.
2

Sharp, pungent.
3 Sharp, sharp-edged, cutting.
4 Cruel, harsh.
mn. (-रः-रं)
Heat.
m. (-रः)
1 An ass.
2 A Rākṣasa, the brother of RĀVAṆ

A Daitya or demon in general.
4 A sort of prickly nightshade.
5 A crow.
6 A heron.
7 An osprey.
f. (-रा)
A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus.)
E.
ख an organ of sense, and रा to get or give, affix क.

mf. (-रः-रिः or -री)
A Khāri, a measure of grain containing sixteen Droṇas, or about three bushels: it is also reckoned at three or four Droṇas; also at five Gonis, which is considered equal to 512 Sers.
f. (-री)
A scar.
E.
खन to dig, deriv. irr.

f. (-टिः or टी)
A barber's shop.
E.
खर heat, and कुटि a dwelling; also written खरकुट्टि.

m. (-णः)
The francoline partridge.
E.
खर heat, कुण to sound, affix अच्.

m. (-णः)
1 The francoline partridge.

f. (-भा)
A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.)

n. (-हं)
An ass's stable.
E.
खर an ass, and गृह a house.

n. (-हं)
A stable for asses.
E.
खर, and गेह a house.

n. (-हं)
A stable for asses.
E.
खर, and ग्रह a house.

m. (-नः)
A plant, commonly Nagesar, (Mesua ferrea.)
E.
खर an ass, and घातन mischievous.

m. (-दः)
1 A kind of reed or grass, (Saccharum cylindricum.)
2 Also another kind, commonly Okera.
E.
खर warm, sharp, छद a leaf.

mfn. (-णाः-णाः-णः)
Sharp-nosed.
E.
खर sharp, नस् from नासिका a nose; also with a final vowel खरणस (-सः-सा-सं.)

n. (-ण्डं)
A lotus, (Nymphaea lotus.)
E.
खर sharp, and दण्ड stick or stem.

f. (-ला)
Opposite leaved fig tree.
E.
खर hot, दल leaf.

m. (-णः)
Thorn apple, (Datura metel.)
E.
खर an ass, and दूषण hurting; by its narcotic properties.

m. (-सी)
A name of RĀMA.
E.
खर an imp or goblin so called, and ध्वंसिन् the destroyer.

m. (-दः)
The braying of an ass.
E.
खर, and नाद noise.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Braying as an ass.
f. (-नी)
A kind of perfume: see रेणुका.
E.
खरनाद and इनि aff.

m. (-त्रः)
1 A red sort of Tulasi or basil.
2 The teak tree, (Tectona grandis.)
E.
खर hot, and पत्र a leaf.

n. (-त्रं)
An iron pot or vessel.
E.
खर an ass, and पात्र a vessel; fit for such an animal.

m. (-कः)
A plant: see तिलक.
E.
कन् added to खरपत्र hot leaved.

m. (-द्यः)
The elephant or wood apple, (Feronia elephantium): see कपित्थ.

m. (-लः)
A wooden vessel.
E.
खर, and पाल what cherishes.

m. (-ष्पः)
A plant, commonly Marüa: see मरुवक.
f. (-ष्पा or ष्पिका)
A kind of Tulasi, (Ocymum gratissimum); also वर्वर.
E.
खर sharp, hot, पुष्प a flower.

m. (-यः)
A pigeon.
E.
खर hot, and प्रिय fond, dear.

f. (-री)
A plant, (Achyranthes aspera): see अपामार्ग.
E.
खर sharp, pungent, and मञ्जरी a pedicle.

n. (-नं)
A vehicle drawn by asses.
E.
खर, and यान a carriage.

m. (-मा)
One of the chiefs of the Nāga or serpent race inhabiting hell.
E.
खर an ass, and लोमन् hair of the body; having the skin of an ass.

f. (-का)
A plant, commonly Gorakṣa Cākuliya, (Hedysarum lagopodiodes.)
E.
खर hot, sharp, वल्लिका a pedicle.

m. (-ब्दः)
1 An osprey.
2 The braying of an ass.
E.
खर, and शब्द sound.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Born or produced in an ass's stall.
f. (-ला)
An ass's stable or stall.
E.
खर, and शाला a hall; in the first sense the final is dropped.

m. (-ल्लः)
An iron vessel; also read खरसोनि.

m. (-शुः)
The sun.
E.
खर hot, and अंशु a ray.

f. (-री)
A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus); also देवताड.
E.
खर venom, गृ to take, with आङ् prefixed, अच् and ङीष् affixes; antivenomous, an antidote.

m. (-कः)
An iron arrow; also खरालिक. m. (-कः).

f. (-श्वा)
A plant, (Celosia cristata.)
E.
खर an ass, अश to be eaten, and व and टाप् affs.

f. (-का)
Musk in powder.
E.
खर, कन् added, fem. form.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
A field, &c. equal to or sown with a Khāri of grain.
E.
खारी the measure, and इकन् or ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Drinking ass's milk.
E.
खरी, and धे to drink, खश् aff.

White.
2

Desirous of improper or prohibited things.
3 A fool, foolish, idiotic^1.
4 Harsh, cruel.
m. (-रुः)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2

A horse.
3 A tooth.
4

Pride.
5
Love or the deity

KĀMA.
6

White, the colour.
E.
खन to dig, &c. Uṇādi affix कु, and र substituted for the final.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

r. 10th cl. (खर्ब्वति)
To go or move.

r. 1st cl. (खर्बंति)
To go, to move to or towards.

mfn. (-र्ब्बः-र्ब्बा-र्ब्बं)
A dwarf, short, low, of little size or stature.
m. (-र्ब्बः)
One of KUVERA'S nine Nidhis or treasures.
n. (-र्ब्बं)
A large number, ten million-millions.
E.
खर्ब्ब or खर्व्व to be small, to go, to move, affix अच्; also खर्व्व.

r. 1st cl. (खर्जति)
1 To worship, to treat with respect or courtesy.
2 To pain or make uneasy.
3 To cleanse or make clean.

f. (-का)
A relish, a provocative to drinking.
E.
खर्ज to pain, and वुन् affix, fem. form.

n. (-रं)
Silver: see खर्ज्जूर.

Silver.
2

The fruit of the date.
3 Yellow orpiment.
m. (-रः)
1 The date tree, (Phoenix sylvestris.)
2 A scorpion.
f. (-री)
The wild date tree.
E.
खर्ज to give pain, &c. Uṇādi affix ऊर.

f. (-र्ज्जूः)
1 Cutaneous eruption, itch, scab, &c.
2 A worm, an insect.
E.
खर्जि to give pain, Uṇādi affix ऊ.

m. (-सः)
The juice or extract of the wild date, Tāri, used to leaven bread, and as an intoxicating liquor, when in a state of spontaneous fermentation.
E.
खर्ज्जूर, and रस juice.

r. 1st cl. (खर्दति)
To bite, to sting, to sting venomously.

mf. (-रः-री)
A kind of collyrium or application to the eyes: see कर्पर.
m. (-रः)
1 A thief.
2 A rogue, a cheat.
3 A beggar's bowl or dish.
4 The half of a skull.
5 An umbrella or parasol.

r. 1st cl. (खर्घति)
To go, to move.

m. (-लः)
A plant: see कन्दराल.

n. (-त्थं)
A sort of collyrium.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खं)
Small, short, dwarfish.
E.
खर्ब्ब short, and शाखा a branch.

n. (-र्म्मं)
1 Virility, manliness.
2 Wovesilk.

r. 1st cl. (खर्व्वति)
To be proud, or haughty.

mfn. (र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं)
A dwarf, &c.: see खर्ब्ब.

mn. (-टः-टं)
1 The capital of a district of four hundred villages, a market or country town.
2 A village at the foot of a mountain.
E.
खर्व्व being proud, and अट what goes or is.

mfn. (-चः-चा-चं)
Cooking a Khāri, by measure (a vessel, &c.)
E.
खारी as above, पच to cook, affix खश्.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
A field sown with a Khāri of grain, &c.
E.
खारी, and वाप sowing.
